title: Greer briefs Admiral Wilson (J2), 1997

tellings.quote: Then in 1997, well, and many other people, but in 97, I briefed the J2, the head of intelligence, joint staff, Admiral Wilson.

plain: In 1997 a UFO disclosure campaigner named Steven Greer says he briefed Admiral Thomas Wilson, the head of intelligence for the Joint Staff (the top military advisers at the Pentagon), about UFOs. Greer tells Michels this himself, and ties it to a memo by the physicist Eric W. Davis that is said to record a later talk with Wilson about hidden UFO programmes. If true, it would mean the military's top intelligence officer was told about secret UFO work.
